get.description: No sign in. Only approved and sealed corrections exist here; anything else is a 404.

No sign in. Speaks an approved, sealed correction in one of its approved languages.

The audio is made the first time someone asks and stored, so the speech service is
called at most once for each message and language. Anything not approved is a 404.

post.description: Text a 6 digit code to the number. Nothing is active until it is confirmed.
Confirm a code for a signup, a preference change or a removal.
Text a code to confirm removal, then confirm it with the confirm endpoint.

The SMS gateway calls this for every text its phone receives (ADR 0010).

The phone is also a personal SIM: texts that do not start with CLARION are dropped
without being stored, logged or answered. Answers 200 for those, so they are not retried.

Telegram calls this for every message sent to the bot.

Always answers 200 for updates we choose to ignore, so Telegram does not retry them.
